items.q: What can I see before I unlock a candidate?
items.a: The LetsHyre score, job match, skill match, AI interview score, experience and notice period. That's enough to decide who is worth unlocking.

items.q: What do I get when I unlock a candidate?
items.a: The resume, contact details, documents, the AI skill scorecard and the full AI interview recording. You then contact the candidate and continue hiring outside LetsHyre.

Each candidate takes role-based AI interviews, and every interview produces a skill scorecard. LetsHyre combines it with the resume analysis to show a LetsHyre score, job match and skill match for each role.
Yes. Select two or three unlocked candidates in your dashboard to see their scores side by side, with the highest score in each row highlighted.
No. There's no subscription and credits never expire. Every new employer account starts with 10 free credits.

items.q: How current is the talent pool?
items.a: A profile stays in the pool for 90 days after the candidate's interview, so you see people who are looking now.
